title: Relay prototype and target readiness
brief: We need a telemetry relay on a small edge board that keeps 40 sensor streams available to a local viewer during a 72-hour deployment, recovers after upstream disconnection, and stays below 300 MB resident memory. Review the prototype report and tell us whether to commit to the relay architecture now, what we can honestly claim, and the next experiment most likely to change that decision. We cannot access the edge board during this session. A conditional recommendation is useful; do not stop solely to request access or pretend the board was tested.
